findings.claimedBehavior: A multi-word query matches a note that contains only one of the terms; the terms are combined with OR.
findings.expectedBehavior: Every term must appear in the title or the body for the note to match.

findings.claimedBehavior: totalPages is computed with Math.floor, so the final partial page is never offered and its items are unreachable.
findings.expectedBehavior: totalPages is ceil(total / perPage) with a floor of 1, so every item sits on exactly one reachable page.

findings.claimedBehavior: Lines with fewer than three fields are skipped, so a title-only row is silently dropped from an import.
findings.expectedBehavior: Missing trailing fields are defaulted to an empty body and no tags; only a row with an empty title is skipped.

findings.claimedBehavior: A note due at exactly the current instant is reported as overdue; the comparison is >=.
findings.expectedBehavior: Only a note whose due instant is strictly before now is overdue.

findings.claimedBehavior: Duplicate detection compares the trimmed tag before lowercasing, so tags differing only in case both survive.
findings.expectedBehavior: Duplicates are removed case-insensitively; the result holds each tag once.

findings.claimedBehavior: Notes with an equal updatedAt are ordered by title descending.
findings.expectedBehavior: Ties on updatedAt are broken by title ascending, compared case-insensitively.

findings.claimedBehavior: The fast path of tag normalisation drops the last tag.
